agreements: Both interpretations and the critique support recording the useful Level1-only scope without treating intentional incompleteness as a failed launch application. Rework concerns a future runnable specification, not permission to stop unrelated authorized builder work. This artifact authorizes no implementation, GPU or model execution, provider action, claim change or workflow transition.

The four proposed conditions are Level1 plus responsive teaching, original initialization plus the same responsive policy with online learning, a SEAL condition whose fidelity remains to be established, and original weights with versioned Markdown memory. Equal responsive policy and opportunities do not require identical realized lessons or prove equal delivered resources.

The frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base, LoRA-only learning, child-authored sleep writes, provenance and contamination exclusions remain constraints. Legitimate shared immutable base ancestry does not imply permission to share mutable learner state or import exposed ancestry. No new L2/L3, deployment, recurrent graph, bridge or hippocampal machinery is required by this proposal.

Only evidence-supported conditional initialization-package and method/system comparisons are contemplated. Starting level, acquisition gain, retention, interference and capability preservation are distinct. Markdown-assisted application and file-free retention are different estimands; removing the frozen baseline's only memory does not establish equal-substrate superiority. Richness causality, original H2, general learning, composition or module credit are not identified by these four labels. Both proposed claims remain headline-ineligible; historical receipts are preserved, not relabelled.

Both interpretations require one-way isolated evaluation and terminal derived reporting. They agree on the intended file-free primary retention and scorer secrecy, but the proposal's missing assisted edge and bundled scorer/model permissions remain actual design conflicts, not permissions supplied by consensus prose.

No primary SEAL fidelity certificate, clean selected lineage, feasible partition, runnable numerical contract or completed acceptance evidence is supplied by this chain. The attributed 97/88/9 enumeration warning establishes neither adequacy nor impossibility; the reported 1024/512 Markdown mismatch is not an adopted budget. Prior source summaries do not verify this method mapping, and structural validation cannot establish independent-context provenance beyond the supplied declarations.

The critique's blocking dependencies and required changes are preserved as rework, without an advocate override. The 24 ambiguity IDs each receive an unresolved top-level resolution; exactly eight explicit interpretation disagreements receive upstream dispositions. Positions describing a proposal omission and an interpreter's requirement are complementary specification positions, not invented inter-interpreter dissent. No numerical, split, statistical or fidelity choice is selected.

All eight acceptance obligations remain necessary. Their modified dispositions request revised coverage only; they do not edit the proposal, register replacements or mark tests passed. Critique missing_acceptance_tests entries 1-11 are assigned below; entry 12 is accepted as the boundary that these are proposed coverage changes, with preimplementation design receipts, pre-GPU checks and post-run scientific evidence kept distinct. Every acceptance reference uses the existing registry. Exact repaired bytes and implementation scope remain Rohin Ghosh's decision after a newly bound deliberation chain.

disagreements.issue: A sufficient partition count does not define an identifiable acquired skill or distinguish retention from transfer.

positions.position: Requests disjoint semantic partitions and identifiable examples but supplies no exact skill/interface or observability and shortcut pass criteria.
Requires legally distinguishable target worlds and nonsealed shortcut fixtures; partition cleanliness alone is insufficient.

resolution.rationale: Accept the objection to the proposed sufficiency criterion, not a particular grammar or a finding that the benchmark fails. systems.partition_feasibility is complementary. No fixtures or skill definitions settle the question.
resolution.required_change: Specify the skill, input evidence and response interface; distinguish same-skill retained knowledge from novel-class transfer. Bind nonsealed paired-world fixtures rejecting contradictory targets for observationally identical worlds and fixtures for raw-query rules, supplied solutions, labels, priors, RAG and explicit-state shortcuts. Do not claim the task forces an unproposed memory mechanism. This preserves missing_acceptance_tests entry 1 and benchmark.partition_is_not_identification; the revised acceptance bytes remain unapproved.

resolution.rationale: The interpretations agree on the missing proof; no allocation, grammar expansion or preparation demand can be inferred from that agreement.
resolution.required_change: Supply a reproducible pinned grammar/domain/equivalence receipt, exact allocation ledger and ancestry exclusions, accounting for SEAL reward/preparation and development needs. Distinguish equivalence on the enumerated finite domain from an expanded domain. Propose rather than silently enlarge a grammar, reuse a split or inspect final cases to obtain feasibility. Preserve the independent observability requirement as well as cardinality.

Fail closed on exposed or unverifiable weights, rows, replay, parent notes, rankings and selection decisions; disclose preparation costs and target exposure. Do not select using FINAL outcomes or resize/reset the Level1 treatment merely to manufacture matching capacity. Preserve lawful shared immutable ancestry, while forbidding accidental mutable sharing.

resolution.required_change: In a future revision bind inspected primary-method/version/task-regime evidence to self-edit generation, learned outer reward policy, inner adaptation, inference, resets, sharing, freezing/continuation and selection. Independently review every deviation and compatibility with the frozen base, LoRA-only writes, child-authored sleep material and one-adapter/state constraints. A second policy state or changed write rule needs explicit invariant disposition, not an inferred exception. If fidelity cannot be supported, return the exact qualified naming or scope conflict to Rohin; do not silently substitute a SEAL-inspired method. Preserve missing_acceptance_tests entry 2.

resolution.required_change: Declare the nonsealed reward source, policy optimizer, candidate selection path, preparation/development/final boundaries and allowed online behavior. Separate preparation, discarded search candidates and online costs. Deny final trajectory inputs, generations, scores and derivatives as reward, retry selection, checkpoint selection or curriculum. Reject undeclared teacher privilege, direct lesson-to-loss copying, unadmitted replay and evaluation-derived rows. Test logs, errors, metadata, caches, shared directories, retrieval indexes and status/gate bits, not just numeric scores. resolution.required_change: Pin clean-context code/math/tool/concise-answer cases, interface, margins, uncertainty and pre/post checkpoint identities before implementation; obtain actual evidence before claims. Acquisition feedback: only legal adaptive access, no retention transcript, derived-only reporting. Sealed data: no adaptive access, model task inputs separated from scorer-only references/scores, derived-only reporting after embargo.
